probe4.title: Probe4 kernel
probe4.desc: probe4 is a built-in kernel shipped with the shell (standalone CLI + its own session files + SSE streaming). It cannot be installed or upgraded, and is not loaded by default — enable it with MHD_ENABLE_KERNELS=probe4.

plugin.probe4.description: The probe4 kernel's desktop surface: kernel version + settings + extensions + models (one entry, three tabs, on par with pi/dsh). Test-only plugin: loaded by tests alone, not part of the production kernel list.
